verses.t: When the sky has split [open]
verses.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder

verses.t: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear

verses.t: And when the earth has been extended
verses.pickthall: And when the earth is spread out

verses.t: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
verses.pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

verses.t: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear

verses.t: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
verses.pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence)

verses.t: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
verses.pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

verses.t: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

verses.t: And return to his people in happiness
verses.pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy

verses.t: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
verses.pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back

verses.t: He will cry out for destruction
verses.pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction

verses.t: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
verses.pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire

verses.t: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
verses.pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk

verses.t: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)

verses.t: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
verses.pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him

verses.t: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset

verses.t: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth

verses.t: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full

verses.t: [That] you will surely experience state after state
verses.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane

verses.t: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe
verses.pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

verses.t: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)

verses.t: But those who have disbelieved deny
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny

verses.t: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
verses.pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding

verses.t: So give them tidings of a painful punishment
verses.pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom

verses.t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing
